Y'all worked your shift — now let Azucar work for you. 🍹💅 Industry Night Drag Show is rolling in this Sunday, built for the bartenders, servers, baristas, and every soul who clocks in while everyone else clocks out. Doors swing open at 9, glitter drops at 10, and the queens are ready to turn your one night off into the highlight of your week. Flash that shift badge and watch the specials appear like magic. Five bucks gets you through the door — cheaper than your well drinks, way more entertaining. This is Azucar's love letter to the weekend warriors who keep this whole city running. Time to be served for once. 💋
